title: Conditions for spatial instabilities and pattern formation from monomial steady state parameterizations
summary: We study the onset of spatial instabilities in reaction networks where the spatially homogeneous system admits a steady state parameterization. We formulate a sufficient condition -- based on the signs of the constant and leading coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of the linearized Jacobian scaled by the diffusion coefficients -- that guarantees a Turing-like instability to spatially inhomogeneous solutions on appropriately chosen domains $Ω$.
